test_cases.title: Register and log in with valid university credentials
test_cases.preconditions: A valid university ID/email is available and the account is eligible.
test_cases.steps: Open portal; register with valid details if needed; log in with valid credentials.
test_cases.expected_result: Account is created/authenticated and a secure session is established.

test_cases.title: Catalogue search returns results within 2 seconds
test_cases.preconditions: Catalogue contains sample books; normal test load is available.
test_cases.steps: Search by title, author, ISBN, subject, and year; measure response time.
test_cases.expected_result: Relevant results and availability are displayed; 95th-percentile response time is at most 2 seconds.

test_cases.title: User submits a digital access request
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in; book is available; account satisfies borrowing rules.
test_cases.steps: Search for an available book; select Request Access; confirm request.
test_cases.expected_result: Request is created as Pending Approval and appears for Admin review; User can view status.

test_cases.title: Eligible User renews a digital loan
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has an active loan eligible for renewal.
test_cases.steps: Open My Loans; select Renew; confirm the action.
test_cases.expected_result: Due date is extended according to configured limits and the new due date is shown.

test_cases.title: User cannot access Admin-only functions
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with the User role.
test_cases.steps: Navigate directly to Admin pages and attempt an Admin-only action.
test_cases.expected_result: System denies access and does not disclose or modify Admin data.

test_cases.title: Expired digital access is revoked automatically
test_cases.preconditions:
1. The User is authenticated.
2. The User has an active digital loan for a book.
3. The loan's expiry time has passed.
4. The User attempts to access the expired book.
test_cases.steps:
.1. Log in as a User with an expired digital loan.
2. Navigate to the expired book's reading page.
3. Attempt to access the book.
4. Check the loan status and relevant audit log entries.
test_cases.expected_result: The system detects that the digital loan has expired when the User attempts to access the book. Reading access is denied, the loan status is updated to the appropriate expired or revoked state, and the expiry event is recorded in the audit log.

test_cases.title: User views loan history and fines
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has current/past loans and a configured fine record.
test_cases.steps: Open My Account; inspect current loans, history, due dates, and fine status.
test_cases.expected_result: Only the User's own accurate loan and fine records are displayed.

test_cases.title: Audit log records authentication and access-control decisions
test_cases.preconditions: Audit logging is enabled; one User account and one Admin account are available; test data includes successful and failed login attempts, a pending access request, and an account-sanction action that can be safely tested.
test_cases.steps: 1. Log in successfully as a User and log out. 2. Submit an invalid login attempt. 3. Submit a digital access request and have the Admin approve or reject it. 4. Renew an eligible loan. 5. Have the Admin apply or remove a test account sanction. 6. Inspect the audit records for these events and attempt to open the audit log as a normal User.
test_cases.expected_result: Successful and failed authentication attempts, access-request decisions, loan renewal, and sanction changes are recorded with actor/system source, timestamp, event type, outcome, and relevant details. A normal User cannot view the audit log.

test_cases.title: User adds and removes a book from favourites
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and a catalogue book exists.
test_cases.steps: Add the book to favourites; open favourites list; remove the book; reopen list.
test_cases.expected_result: Book appears after adding and no longer appears after removal; list is associated with the correct User.

test_cases.title: User reads a book with valid approved access
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has approved, unexpired digital access to a book.
test_cases.steps: Open the selected book from My Loans; navigate within the online reader.
test_cases.expected_result: Book content opens and can be read through the web interface while access remains valid.

test_cases.title: User without valid access is denied online reading
test_cases.preconditions: User has no approved loan, or the loan has expired/revoked.
test_cases.steps: Attempt to open the book reader URL directly.
test_cases.expected_result: System denies access and does not expose book content.

test_cases.title: User requests access again to a previously borrowed book
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, has borrowed the book before, book is available, and account is eligible.
test_cases.steps: Open borrowing history; select a previously borrowed book; choose Request Access Again.
test_cases.expected_result: A new access request is created with a visible status after availability and account checks.

test_cases.title: Repeat borrowing is blocked when book or account is ineligible
test_cases.preconditions: Previously borrowed book is unavailable or the User account fails an eligibility rule.
test_cases.steps: Attempt Request Access Again.
test_cases.expected_result: No invalid request is created; system explains the availability or account restriction.

test_cases.title: Admin reviews an access request and approves or rejects it
test_cases.preconditions: An access request is pending and Admin is authenticated.
test_cases.steps: Open pending requests; approve one request and reject another; inspect statuses and audit log.
test_cases.expected_result: Each decision updates the request status, is visible to User, and is recorded in the audit log.

test_cases.title: Admin applies and removes account sanctions
test_cases.preconditions: Admin is authenticated; a configured violation alert exists for a test account.
test_cases.steps: Review alert; suspend or ban the account; verify access restrictions; restore/unban with a reason; inspect audit log.
test_cases.expected_result: Admin can apply/remove permitted restrictions; access follows account status; each action, reason, and timestamp is logged.

test_cases.title: Suspended or banned User cannot read digital books
test_cases.preconditions: A test account is suspended or banned by Admin.
test_cases.steps: Log in or use an existing session; attempt to open a digital book.
test_cases.expected_result: Restricted account cannot access protected reading functions; denial is recorded as required.

test_cases.title: Copyright violation fine follows confirmed severity level
test_cases.preconditions: An authenticated Admin and a test member are available. Three suspected copyright violation records have been created with no severity assigned and no fines issued. The Admin can access the violation management page, review each record, and select a severity level before issuing a fine.
test_cases.steps: Admin opens the violation management page;Admin reviews and confirms the first violation and issues a fine at Level 1;Repeat for violations at Levels 2 and 3;Verify each fine record and its amount;Log in as the affected member and open the fine list
test_cases.expected_result: The system creates fines of 10,000 VND for Level 1, 20,000 VND for Level 2, and 50,000 VND for Level 3 only after the violations are confirmed. Each fine is linked to its violation record, displays the correct amount and payment status, and is visible to the affected member.

test_cases.title: Audit log cannot be viewed by a normal User
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with the User role.
test_cases.steps: Attempt to open the audit-log page or API directly.
test_cases.expected_result: System denies access to audit records; no audit data is disclosed.

test_cases.title: Member can reserve a book with no available digital copies
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in; the selected book has no available digital copies and can be reserved.
test_cases.steps: Search for the book;Open its details;Select Reserve;Confirm the reservation
test_cases.expected_result: A reservation is added to the queue and its status is shown to the member. No digital access is granted before a copy becomes available.

test_cases.title: Member is notified of successful renewal and updated expiry date
test_cases.preconditions: A member has an active digital loan and has not exceeded the maximum of two renewals.
test_cases.steps: Submit a renewal request for the active loan; approve the renewal if approval is required; check the renewal confirmation notification and the updated loan expiry date.
test_cases.expected_result: The system confirms the successful renewal to the member, updates the loan expiry date according to the renewal rules, and records the renewal count. The member can renew the same loan no more than twice.

test_cases.title: Member is notified when their account is banned due to suspected copyright infringement
test_cases.preconditions: A member account has been flagged for suspected copyright infringement, and the Admin has banned the account. The notification service is available.
test_cases.steps: Flag the member account for suspected copyright infringement; ban the account as Admin; check the notification record and its associated member account.
test_cases.expected_result: The system sends a notification informing the member that their account has been banned due to suspected copyright infringement. The notification is associated with the correct member account, and no unrelated member is notified.

test_cases.title: Audit log records reservation, return, and fine transactions
test_cases.preconditions: Audit logging is enabled; a User and Admin account are available; test records exist for a reservation, a loan that can be returned, and a fine that can be created or adjusted.
test_cases.steps: 1. Place a reservation for an unavailable digital book. 2. Cancel a separate test reservation, if cancellation is supported. 3. Process the return or closure of a test loan. 4. Create or adjust a test fine. 5. Inspect the audit records for each circulation and financial transaction.
test_cases.expected_result: Each reservation action, return/loan closure, and fine creation or adjustment has its own accurate audit record containing actor/system source, timestamp, transaction type, related book/loan/reservation/member, and relevant details. No performed transaction is missing. This test verifies circulation/financial records, not authentication or access-control events.

test_cases.title: Web forms reject injection and safely encode script input
test_cases.preconditions: A test environment is available; catalogue search or another text input accepts user-provided text; security testing is authorized.
test_cases.steps: Submit a harmless SQL-injection test string and an XSS test string in the input field;Inspect the response and application data
test_cases.expected_result: Input is handled as data, not executable SQL or script; no unauthorized data change occurs and no script executes in the browser.
